ask.example: She asked for a glass of water
He asked her out for dinner
I'll ask around and see if anyone knows a good plumber
She asked after your mother when I saw her
ask.note: Mais comum em inglês britânico e um pouco menos frequente

break.meaning: quebrar/parar de funcionar; perder controle emocional
break.example: Our car broke down on the highway
break.note: Para pessoa: break down in tears

break.example: They broke up after five years together

break.meaning: entrar à força; amaciar algo novo
break.example: Someone tried to break in last night
break.note: break in new shoes = amaciar sapatos novos

break.meaning: entrar à força em um local
break.example: Someone broke into the office over the weekend

break.meaning: começar de repente, especialmente incêndio, guerra ou doença
break.example: A fire broke out in the kitchen
They broke off the negotiations after two days

bring.example: She brought the issue up during the meeting
This song brings back a lot of memories
They brought in a consultant to review the process

bring.meaning: lançar; destacar ou fazer aparecer uma qualidade
bring.example: The new lighting brings out the color of the walls

call.example: I'll call you back after the meeting
They called the game off because of the rain

call.meaning: pedir que alguém participe ou responda; visitar
call.example: The teacher called on Maria to answer the question
I called him up to ask about the job
The situation calls for a different approach

carry.pattern: carry on + -ing / carry on with + noun
carry.example: She carried on working despite the noise
carry.note: Muito comum em inglês britânico; também entendido amplamente

carry.example: The team carried out a safety inspection
carry.note: Não costuma ser separado quando o objeto é longo; com pronome: carry it out

carry.meaning: transferir ou continuar para outro período
carry.example: Unused vacation days can be carried over to next year

carry.meaning: levar até o fim ou cumprir
carry.example: She carried the project through despite the delays
carry.note: Menos comum que carry out, mas útil para ideia de conclusão

check.pattern: check in / check in at + place
check.example: We checked in at the hotel around three
check.note: Para voo/hotel; também check in online

check.example: Check out this new café near the office
I'll check up on the repair this afternoon
check.note: Não é separável como expressão completa

check.example: Can you check on the kids before you go to bed?
The mechanic checked the car over before the trip

come.example: She came back from lunch around two
come.note: Muito comum para retorno ao lugar de referência do falante

come.example: Come in and take a seat
come.note: Também pode significar chegar/estar disponível em certos contextos

come.meaning: sair, ser lançado ou tornar-se conhecido
come.example: The new version comes out next month
That issue came up during the meeting

come.meaning: encontrar por acaso; parecer de determinada forma
come.pattern: come across + person/thing / come across as + adjective
come.example: I came across an old photo while cleaning

come.meaning: vir até a casa/local de alguém
come.example: Why don't you come over after work?
come.note: Uso muito comum em convites informais

cut.pattern: cut down on + noun / cut + object + down
cut.example: I'm trying to cut down on sugar
cut.note: cut down on = reduzir consumo; cut a tree down = derrubar árvore

cut.example: We need to cut back on unnecessary spending
The storm cut off power to several homes
She cut caffeine out of her diet
cut.note: Com pronome: cut it out; como comando, Cut it out! = Pare com isso

drop.example: I'll drop you off at the station
I'll drop by after work if you're home

drop.meaning: aparecer sem combinar, fazer visita rápida
drop.pattern: drop in / drop in on + person
drop.example: She dropped in for coffee yesterday
drop.note: drop in on someone = visitar alguém sem grande formalidade

drop.pattern: drop out / drop out of + noun
drop.example: He dropped out of college after his first year
drop.note: Use drop out of antes do curso/programa

fall.example: The old chair is starting to fall apart
fall.note: Também usado para planos, relações e estado emocional

fall.pattern: fall behind / fall behind on + work/payments
fall.example: I fell behind on my emails while I was away
fall.note: Muito comum com work, payments, schedule

fall.example: He fell for the scam and lost some money
fall.note: O contexto distingue paixão de ser enganado

fall.meaning: brigar e deixar de ter boa relação
fall.example: They fell out over money last year
fall.note: Mais comum no inglês britânico; fall out over + motivo

fall.example: The deal fell through at the last minute
fall.note: Normalmente o plano/acordo é o sujeito

get.example: I usually get up around seven on weekdays
What time did you get back last night?
get.note: Com objeto: get your money back

get.example: We got in just before the rain started
get.note: Para carro pequeno/táxi, é comum get in / get into

get.pattern: get out / get out of + place
get.example: We need to get out of the building now
get.note: get out of também pode significar evitar uma obrigação

get.meaning: entrar em transporte maior; ter boa relação
get.pattern: get on + transport / get on with + person
get.example: We got on the bus near the station
get.note: get on with someone = dar-se bem com alguém

get.meaning: sair de transporte; terminar o trabalho
get.pattern: get off + transport / get off work
get.example: We got off the train at the next stop
get.note: Também: get off work at six

get.example: It took her a week to get over the flu
get.note: Não é separável: get over it

get.meaning: conseguir terminar, sobreviver ou conseguir contato
get.pattern: get through + task / period / to + person
get.example: I finally got through all my emails
get.note: get through to someone = conseguir contato ou fazê-lo entender

give.example: He gave up smoking last year

give.meaning: dar de graça; revelar sem querer
give.example: They gave away all the old furniture
give.note: give away a secret = revelar um segredo

give.example: Can you give my book back tomorrow?

give.pattern: give in / give in to + pressure/person
give.example: She finally gave in and agreed to go
give.note: give in to pressure = ceder à pressão

give.example: They gave out maps at the entrance
give.note: Também: My phone battery gave out

go.example: She went on talking even after the meeting had ended
go.note: Também: What's going on? = O que está acontecendo?

go.example: We went out for dinner after work
go.note: Para luz/fogo: The lights went out

go.example: My alarm went off at six this morning
go.note: Também usado para comida que estragou

go.example: Let's go over the numbers one more time
She went through a difficult period last year
go.note: Também: go through the documents = revisar os documentos

go.example: I need to go back to the office for my keys
go.note: go back to a topic = retomar um assunto

go.pattern: go ahead / go ahead with + plan
go.example: They decided to go ahead with the renovation
go.note: Também usado para dar permissão: Go ahead
